subject: Increased latency & errors during Nov 26-27 window — request for compensation
messages:
From: Chris Miller <chris@uptick.io>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Cc: elena.ortiz@uptick.io; uptick-platform-alerts@uptick.io
Date: Fri, 28 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Production latency & 503s — Nov 26 23:30 to Nov 27 02:00 PST

Hi Soojin,

We saw a sustained period of very high latency and a spike of 5xx responses across our inference endpoints during the window listed above. This degraded the customer experience for our checkout pipeline and forced us to fall back to a degraded local model for ~1500 requests. The attached incident log (generated by our monitoring) shows the error bursts and client-side retries.

Can you share what happened on your side and what remediation/compensation you can offer? This incident hit peak usage in our busiest hour of the day and materially impacted revenue for several of our merchants.

We are evaluating whether to move more workloads to a second vendor unless we can get reassurance on recurrence controls and some remediation here.

Thanks,
Chris Miller
Head of Platform
Uptick Analytics

Attachment: uptick_incident_log.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Chris Miller <chris@uptick.io>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 28 Nov 2025 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Production latency & 503s — Nov 26 23:30 to Nov 27 02:00 PST

Hi Chris — thank you for the log and the heads up. I’m really sorry Uptick ran into this — we know that kind of blip during peak hours is unacceptable.

We’ve pulled the service logs and an initial RCA looks like an autoscaling miscoordination on a routing tier combined with an unexpected token cache eviction for a subset of long-running sessions (we’re seeing elevated seq lengths + cache churn). Engineering is collecting a full timeline; I’ve attached the first-pass notes.

Proposed short-term make-good (pending manager/finance approvals):
- 75,000 free token credits applied to Uptick’s account (usable across generation & embedding endpoints)
- 30-day trial extension on your current evaluation bundle (expires extended from 2025-12-15 to 2026-01-14)
- Dedicated post-mortem with our SREs and your platform team next week to review mitigations (we’ll share runbooks + caching recommendations)

Can you confirm if this would be reasonable as an interim resolution while we finish the post-mortem? If yes I’ll request LA/Finance sign-off and send a formal make-good package.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Nov 2025 13:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Production latency & 503s — Nov 26 23:30 to Nov 27 02:00 PST

Soojin — thanks for the write-up and for pulling the initial timeline. This sounds like a clear incident where we should offer a meaningful one-off to maintain trust given the customer impact and revenue sensitivity.

Approve the following make-good as an interim customer-facing offer:
- 75,000 token credit applied within 48 hours
- 30-day extension on current trial/bundle
- A 60-minute technical post-mortem session scheduled with SRE + product engineering (we’ll include a short mitigation plan and SLA guardrails)

Monica, please prepare the make-good agreement and the accounting entry for the token credit. Aditya, please coordinate pricing/contract note so we capture any upsell triggers.

Soojin, once you confirm Uptick accepts, we’ll finalize the package and route for signature.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Dir. Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

(On Fri, 28 Nov 2025 at 10:04, Soojin Lee wrote:)
> Hi Chris — thank you for the log and the heads up...

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Chris Miller <chris@uptick.io>
Cc: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@uptick.io>, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 Nov 2025 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Redwood make-good offer for Nov 26-27 outage window

Hi Chris / Elena — following our internal approvals, thanks for your patience. Below is the formal offer for the incident on Nov 26 (23:30 PST) — Nov 27 (02:00 PST):

Offer details (account: Uptick Analytics / deal UPTK-4921)
- 75,000 token credit applied to your account within 48 hours (credit ID: MG-20251128-UPTK)
- 30-day extension of your current evaluation bundle (new expiry: 2026-01-14)
- One 60-minute technical post-mortem with our SRE and product eng leads (please propose 2 times next week that work for your team)
- We will share a short mitigation checklist and a recommended model quantization/profile to reduce sequence churn for your checkout workload.

Attachments: makegood_proposal.xlsx (line-item summary), uptick_trial_extension_agreement.pdf

Next steps:
1) Confirm acceptance of the offer in reply to this email. If accepted, Monica will provision the credit and update your billing record.
2) Provide two available 60-minute windows for the post-mortem and we’ll send a calendar invite.
3) If you want the credit converted to a dollar-equivalent invoice adjustment, confirm and we’ll route to Finance (this will delay provisioning by 1–2 business days).

We value Uptick as a partner and want to make this right — please let me know if you need anything else while we complete the RCA.

Best regards,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
